commits.message:
kern-serve: vendor the frontend with a renderer seam and the deepseek_v41 chat renderer

pegainfer-frontend (pegainfer 1e3b6f2) and vllm-chat (vLLM d3e2888)
move under vendor/ with their Apache-2.0 licenses and an UPSTREAM.md
each stating the pin and the local change. The frontend gains one
public renderer selection threaded into the existing server
configuration; vllm-chat gains the native deepseek_v41 renderer, built
from the released encoding reference and checked against its text
goldens (tests/fixtures/deepseek_v41.json, regenerated by
tools/dsv41/test_renderer_reference.py). kern-serve exposes it as
--renderer (default auto). The renderer's tool-call output parser is
not adapted yet.

Both vendored crates are excluded from the kern-serve workspace so its
lints stay its own; vllm-chat is a dev-dependency reached through a
[patch] on the upstream git URL.
